scope: Curated public-source research; complete observed 21st directory category coverage, not exhaustive demo verification or an internet archive.

patterns.name: Quiet release strip
patterns.variants: Dismissible update; maintenance notice; inline launch badge
patterns.use: An update affects the current audience or task.
patterns.guard: Date the message; persist sensible dismissal; avoid blocking essential controls.
patterns.fallback: Inline text notice with a detail link.

patterns.name: Textured technical illustration
patterns.variants: Monospace silhouette; dithered product; terminal backdrop
patterns.use: Developer/editorial identity benefits from a distinctive illustration.
patterns.guard: Keep real headings in HTML; decorative glyphs must not flood screen readers.
patterns.fallback: Static image with appropriate alternative text.

patterns.name: Layered atmosphere
patterns.variants: Grid; grain; contour; aurora; silhouette
patterns.use: A public page needs depth without competing with content.
patterns.guard: Keep text over a stable surface; bound rendering and contrast.
patterns.fallback: Solid tone or compressed static asset.

patterns.name: Purposeful edge treatment
patterns.variants: Hairline; inset frame; corner marks; tracing accent
patterns.use: Separate related regions or emphasize one object.
patterns.guard: Do not confuse decoration with focus or selection; keep hit areas intact.
patterns.fallback: Stable outline with explicit state label.

patterns.name: Decision-focused action panel
patterns.variants: Inline action; closing band; contextual next step
patterns.use: The visitor has enough information to choose.
patterns.guard: State consequence and commitment; avoid repetitive competing primary actions.
patterns.fallback: Plain action link or button near explanation.

patterns.name: Credible customer evidence
patterns.variants: Logo row; sector groups; linked case studies
patterns.use: Relevant real customers establish context.
patterns.guard: Use permissioned logos and accurate relationship descriptions.
patterns.fallback: Named text list with case-study links.

patterns.name: Decision matrix
patterns.variants: Feature table; before/after; side-by-side variants
patterns.use: Users must understand meaningful differences.
patterns.guard: Use comparable units and dates; avoid hiding unfavorable facts.

patterns.name: Compact tool launcher
patterns.variants: Floating app dock; contextual action shelf
patterns.use: A small familiar toolset needs frequent access.
patterns.guard: Labels on keyboard/touch; no magnification required to hit targets.

patterns.name: Objection-oriented answers
patterns.variants: Grouped questions; search; linked answer sections
patterns.use: Common questions need concise discoverable explanations.
patterns.guard: Keep essential commitments outside collapsed content.

patterns.name: Capability storytelling
patterns.variants: Alternating media/text; modular proof; interactive demo
patterns.use: Explain how a capability changes a real workflow.
patterns.guard: Pair claims with truthful examples; do not depend on hover-only content.

patterns.name: Useful destination index
patterns.variants: Grouped sitemap; support; compact utility bar
patterns.use: Users seek contact, policies, secondary routes, or reassurance.
patterns.guard: Keep labels meaningful and current; avoid a link graveyard.

patterns.name: Contextual work explorer
patterns.variants: Editorial grid; filmstrip; masonry; lightbox
patterns.use: Visual work benefits from browsing and closer inspection.
patterns.guard: Preserve reading order, captions, keyboard navigation, and return position.
patterns.fallback: Regular image list with detail links.

patterns.name: Controlled color field
patterns.variants: Radial spotlight; mesh; duotone; edge glow
patterns.use: Brand atmosphere or a subtle hierarchy cue is useful.
patterns.guard: Test worst-case contrast; don't encode meaning only in a gradient.

patterns.name: Specific opening statement
patterns.variants: Editorial type; split product; evidence-first; guided demo
patterns.use: The first screen must establish value and next action.
patterns.guard: Keep explanation and action available before optional effects load.

patterns.name: Reusable interaction behavior
patterns.variants: Outside-click; resize; reduced-motion; visibility helper
patterns.use: Several components share real behavior.
patterns.guard: Audit cleanup, stale closures, SSR assumptions, and event subscriptions.
patterns.fallback: Native event behavior with minimal script.

patterns.name: Art-directed media
patterns.variants: Context crop; framed screenshot; annotated image; zoom
patterns.use: An image explains content or reinforces identity.
patterns.guard: Provide useful alt text when informative; reserve dimensions; honor rights.

patterns.name: Location-aware explorer
patterns.variants: Result pins; selected route; region summary
patterns.use: Geography changes a user's decision.
patterns.guard: Provide a synchronized list, address search, clear precision, and permission boundaries.

patterns.name: Optional moving texture
patterns.variants: Logo ribbon; phrase band; image rail
patterns.use: Nonessential repetition supports a brand moment.
patterns.guard: Don't hide unique information in motion; offer pause when applicable.

patterns.name: Predictable destination system
patterns.variants: Simple header; grouped mega-menu; mobile drawer
patterns.use: Visitors need to understand where they can go.
patterns.guard: Keep destination links as links; distinguish disclosure controls; preserve keyboard paths.

patterns.name: Honest plan chooser
patterns.variants: Tier cards; usage estimate; comparison; billing selector
patterns.use: Users compare entitlement and total commitment.
patterns.guard: Show currency, period, taxes/fees as applicable, limits, and renewal behavior.
patterns.fallback: Readable plan list and comparison table.

patterns.name: Local overflow with orientation
patterns.variants: Code viewport; activity log; bounded list
patterns.use: A bounded region genuinely improves context.
patterns.guard: Avoid nested-scroll traps; show affordance and permit keyboard scrolling.

patterns.name: Bounded procedural art
patterns.variants: Fluid color; halftone; reflective material; light field
patterns.use: An optional visual moment warrants rendering cost.
patterns.guard: Measure GPU use; handle context loss; keep content in DOM.

patterns.name: Contextual outcome metrics
patterns.variants: Metric strip; trend card; target comparison
patterns.use: A number can inform a decision with context.
patterns.guard: Supply denominator, period, source, and meaning; label demo data.

patterns.name: Resumable task progression
patterns.variants: Labeled stages; check answers; edit previous step
patterns.use: A lengthy task has meaningful stages.
patterns.guard: Preserve drafts and errors; distinguish current, complete, and skipped.

patterns.name: Real people and roles
patterns.variants: Portrait grid; expertise list; story cards
patterns.use: People's qualifications or responsibilities matter.
patterns.guard: Use truthful names, roles, and permissioned images.

patterns.name: Verifiable customer story
patterns.variants: Quote with context; case-study card; video evidence
patterns.use: A relevant experience supports an honest claim.
patterns.guard: Get permission; state attribution; no fabricated reviews or misleading selection.

patterns.name: Expressive type treatment
patterns.variants: Editorial scale; highlight; reveal; typographic interlude
patterns.use: A brief headline or brand moment benefits.
patterns.guard: Render complete accessible text; avoid delaying comprehension or duplicating spoken text.

patterns.name: Meaningful sequence
patterns.variants: Audit history; project phases; story milestones
patterns.use: Order and change over time explain the subject.
patterns.guard: Label dates/time zones and pending states; avoid implying false causality.

patterns.name: User-controlled demonstration
patterns.variants: Product walkthrough; case study; ambient clip
patterns.use: Motion explains something a still cannot.
patterns.guard: Captions/transcript when needed; controls; poster; no unexpected sound.

patterns.name: Progressive detail
patterns.variants: Single section; independent sections; grouped detail
patterns.use: Users need optional detail without losing overview.
patterns.guard: Give headings and controls clear names; don't conceal required decisions.

patterns.name: Controllable assistant workspace
patterns.variants: Streaming response; sources; attachment tray; approval card
patterns.use: A conversation is useful for the actual task.
patterns.guard: Show stop/retry/error, distinguish drafts from actions, and enforce backend permissions.
patterns.fallback: Form-based task submission and durable result.

patterns.name: Scoped important feedback
patterns.variants: Inline error; page status; consequence warning
patterns.use: A relevant condition needs attention.
patterns.guard: Match urgency to severity; offer resolution without repeated interruption.
patterns.fallback: Persistent text near the affected task.

patterns.name: Recognizable identity
patterns.variants: Initials; portrait; small group; presence marker
patterns.use: Identity matters to collaboration or ownership.
patterns.guard: Handle missing images and identical initials; label presence explicitly.

patterns.name: Concise state label
patterns.variants: Status pill; count; qualification
patterns.use: A short label adds scannable context.
patterns.guard: Don't rely on color; define ambiguous counts and states.

patterns.name: Clear action with feedback
patterns.variants: Solid primary; quiet secondary; icon+label; stateful
patterns.use: An operation changes something.
patterns.guard: Keep labels and target stable; support pending/error; avoid nested interactive elements.

patterns.name: Temporal overview
patterns.variants: Month grid; agenda; resource schedule
patterns.use: Users compare events or availability in time.
patterns.guard: Account for locale/time zone, keyboard operation, dense days, and conflicts.

patterns.name: Object summary with hierarchy
patterns.variants: Editorial card; actionable record; media tile; expandable summary
patterns.use: An object merits a short preview before detail.
patterns.guard: Make primary destination clear; preserve semantics for nested actions.

patterns.name: Optional sequential browsing
patterns.variants: Manual slides; filmstrip; snap rail
patterns.use: Space is limited and users benefit from sequence.
patterns.guard: Expose controls and position; avoid trapping focus or auto-rotating essential content.

patterns.name: Decision-oriented visualization
patterns.variants: Trend; distribution; comparison; small multiples
patterns.use: A relationship is easier to see graphically.
patterns.guard: Label units, uncertainty, missingness, source and range; supply accessible data.

patterns.name: Independent selection
patterns.variants: Single consent; multi-select; indeterminate parent
patterns.use: Zero or more independent choices apply.
patterns.guard: Separate required consent from optional; handle mixed selection accurately.

patterns.name: Optional pointer ornament
patterns.variants: Soft follower; contextual label; image preview
patterns.use: An expressive desktop scene gains context.
patterns.guard: Keep system cursor and stable targets; no essential information follows pointer alone.

patterns.name: Prioritized work overview
patterns.variants: Exception queue; trends; role home; drill-down
patterns.use: Users need an overview to decide their next task.
patterns.guard: Prioritize action over ornamental metrics; include freshness and scope.
patterns.fallback: Ordered work list and concise summaries.

patterns.name: Flexible date entry
patterns.variants: Typed date; calendar popover; range; presets
patterns.use: People need to choose dates confidently.
patterns.guard: Accept keyboard entry; specify locale and time zone; explain disabled dates.
patterns.fallback: Validated text fields with format help.

patterns.name: Focused bounded decision
patterns.variants: Confirmation; small editor; critical acknowledgement
patterns.use: A short task requires blocking the background.
patterns.guard: Define focus, dismissal, dirty state, and return target; avoid nested modals.

patterns.name: Compact disclosure
patterns.variants: Action menu; navigation disclosure; choice list
patterns.use: Hidden options are secondary and discoverable.
patterns.guard: Choose correct semantics: actions, destinations, and value selection differ.

patterns.name: Useful next step
patterns.variants: First use; no matches; cleared queue; permission denial
patterns.use: The absence of content has a clear cause.
patterns.guard: Explain the specific cause and offer relevant action; do not call an error empty.

patterns.name: Hierarchical resource explorer
patterns.variants: Nested folders; lazy branches; path breadcrumbs
patterns.use: Real hierarchy is useful for navigation.
patterns.guard: Keep keyboard and selection behavior consistent; handle deep paths.

patterns.name: Recoverable transfer
patterns.variants: Drop zone; browse; queue; preview; resume
patterns.use: Users provide files or media.
patterns.guard: Always include file picker; validate on server; show individual failure and cancellation.
patterns.fallback: Native file input with status list.

patterns.name: Task-shaped data collection
patterns.variants: Single column; grouped fields; staged flow
patterns.use: Collect only the data needed for the outcome.
patterns.guard: Persistent labels, useful errors, preserved values, and review for consequences.

patterns.name: Optional global story
patterns.variants: Coverage globe; connected regions; orbital markers
patterns.use: A global narrative benefits from spatial context.
patterns.guard: Don't use a decorative globe as sole evidence of coverage; provide region list.

patterns.name: Hierarchical content modules
patterns.variants: Asymmetric feature tiles; summary grid; editorial mosaic
patterns.use: Related content differs in importance and shape.
patterns.guard: DOM order must match meaning; don't squeeze long content to preserve a shape.

patterns.name: Consistent visual shorthand
patterns.variants: Outline; filled; duotone; state pair
patterns.use: A familiar symbol improves scanning.
patterns.guard: Label ambiguous/interactive icons; normalize stroke and optical size; preserve rights.

patterns.name: Clear editable values
patterns.variants: Text; search; number; segmented verification
patterns.use: Users must enter and correct data.
patterns.guard: Choose appropriate input type and autocomplete; allow paste; don't mask unexpectedly.

patterns.name: Predictable destinations
patterns.variants: Inline; card destination; external resource
patterns.use: An action navigates to another resource.
patterns.guard: Use meaningful text and valid URLs; distinguish downloads and consequential destinations.

patterns.name: Scannable collections
patterns.variants: Dense rows; media list; grouped activity
patterns.use: People compare or scan repeated objects.
patterns.guard: Stable identity, clear sorting, useful truncation, and scoped item actions.

patterns.name: Discoverable commands
patterns.variants: Menu button; context menu; overflow actions
patterns.use: Secondary commands should remain reachable.
patterns.guard: Context menu cannot be the only route; avoid hiding frequent tasks.

patterns.name: Durable event inbox
patterns.variants: Grouped feed; unread filter; channel preferences
patterns.use: Events matter after a transient message disappears.
patterns.guard: Deduplicate, deep-link to authorized context, and distinguish unread from unresolved.

patterns.name: Legible changing values
patterns.variants: Tabular values; gentle transition; unit suffix
patterns.use: Metrics update and comparison matters.
patterns.guard: Render real final value immediately for assistive tech; don't animate critical balances misleadingly.

patterns.name: First useful outcome
patterns.variants: Checklist; contextual hint; sample workspace
patterns.use: New users need help reaching value.
patterns.guard: Skip optional steps; return later; avoid compulsory tours and fake completion.

patterns.name: Navigable result sets
patterns.variants: Page links; load more; cursor navigation
patterns.use: Result size exceeds a useful view.
patterns.guard: Preserve filter/history state; show position and handle removed records.

patterns.name: Anchored supplemental work
patterns.variants: Filter editor; small help panel; quick preview
patterns.use: A bounded task benefits from staying beside its origin.
patterns.guard: Handle collision, focus, outside click, and keyboard; use dialog semantics if modal.

patterns.name: Identity and account context
patterns.variants: Public bio; workspace role; editable account
patterns.use: Identity or preferences affect the task.
patterns.guard: Separate public/private information; clearly scope account versus workspace edits.

patterns.name: Truthful task status
patterns.variants: Measured bar; stage list; background-job tracker
patterns.use: Work takes long enough to need status.
patterns.guard: Distinguish measured and indeterminate progress; expose failure and cancellation.
patterns.fallback: Text stage and durable job link.

patterns.name: Mutually exclusive choice
patterns.variants: Inline options; choice cards; segmented choice
patterns.use: Exactly one option in a known set applies.
patterns.guard: Use real selection semantics and labels; no hidden preselected paid commitments.

patterns.name: Find with context
patterns.variants: Suggestions; scoped search; recent queries; command entry
patterns.use: Users know something about the destination.
patterns.guard: Label scope; support empty/no-result/error states; don't leak recent sensitive queries.

patterns.name: Compact value choice
patterns.variants: Native select; searchable combobox; grouped options
patterns.use: A known set supplies a value.
patterns.guard: Prefer simpler control when adequate; test long options, typing, and mobile.

patterns.name: Stable workspace orientation
patterns.variants: Expanded navigation; compact rail; contextual inspector
patterns.use: Repeated work benefits from consistent context.
patterns.guard: Current route and collapse state stay clear; small screens need reachable alternatives.

patterns.name: Trustworthy account entry
patterns.variants: Password/passkey; SSO; account chooser
patterns.use: Returning users need access with recovery.
patterns.guard: Reveal/hide, autofill/paste, recovery, useful safe errors; avoid decorative friction.

patterns.name: Minimal account creation
patterns.variants: Invitation; progressive profile; SSO
patterns.use: An account is justified by the next task.
patterns.guard: Explain benefits and required data; verify identity appropriately; preserve progress.
patterns.fallback: Short form with explicit terms and next step.

patterns.name: Approximate range adjustment
patterns.variants: Single value; range; comparison scrubber
patterns.use: Continuous or approximate selection is natural.
patterns.guard: Provide keyboard and precise numeric alternative where precision matters.

patterns.name: Bounded waiting cue
patterns.variants: Inline spinner; skeleton; stage status
patterns.use: A short unknown duration needs feedback.
patterns.guard: Don't imply determinate progress; expose slow/failure state rather than spinning forever.
patterns.fallback: Text status with retry when available.

patterns.name: Reliable structured comparison
patterns.variants: Sortable table; sticky key column; selectable rows
patterns.use: Rows share attributes users compare.
patterns.guard: Keep headers and meaning; selection/bulk actions respect permissions; scope sticky overflow.
patterns.fallback: Accessible table or labeled record list.

patterns.name: Related views in one context
patterns.variants: Content panels; view switcher; vertical categories
patterns.use: Users switch between peer content panels.
patterns.guard: Distinguish route links from tabs; implement keyboard state; preserve meaningful selection.

patterns.name: Manageable descriptors
patterns.variants: Filter chips; removable labels; taxonomy
patterns.use: Descriptors help organize or narrow content.
patterns.guard: Name remove actions; retain visible active-filter context and reset.

patterns.name: Comfortable longer entry
patterns.variants: Auto-grow; preview; counter; draft
patterns.use: People compose meaningful text.
patterns.guard: Don't resize disruptively; preserve drafts and errors; explain limits before loss.

patterns.name: Brief acknowledgement
patterns.variants: Saved; copied; reversible dismissal
patterns.use: Noncritical feedback can be transient.
patterns.guard: Never sole record of critical failure; don't steal focus; give undo enough time or durable access.

patterns.name: Immediate binary setting
patterns.variants: Switch; pressed tool; visibility choice
patterns.use: The user changes a clear two-state setting.
patterns.guard: Label state and save failure; distinguish toggle buttons from switches and submit-based choices.

patterns.name: Supplementary explanation
patterns.variants: Icon label; concise clarification; shortcut hint
patterns.use: Nonessential extra explanation aids discovery.
patterns.guard: No interactive controls or indispensable instructions; support focus and dismissal.

patterns.name: Paper grain editorial
patterns.variants: Warm paper; restrained grain; ink frame
patterns.use: Human, crafted brands and long-form stories.
patterns.guard: Keep texture subtle and away from fine text; avoid large raster downloads.

patterns.name: Topographic storytelling
patterns.variants: Contour fields; elevation bands; route motif
patterns.use: Place, systems, or provenance is part of the story.
patterns.guard: Don't present invented contours as actual measured geography.

patterns.name: Isometric system cutaway
patterns.variants: Layered system; room cutaway; process stack
patterns.use: Explain relationships that photography cannot show.
patterns.guard: Add a labeled diagram/list; don't make reading depend on rotation.

patterns.name: Collage with discipline
patterns.variants: Cutout subjects; paper layers; editorial captions
patterns.use: A creative brand has a strong image collection.
patterns.guard: Unify crop, lighting, and edge treatment; manage image rights.

patterns.name: Technical schematic art
patterns.variants: Exploded diagram; node map; circuit field
patterns.use: A technical product needs an explanatory visual identity.
patterns.guard: Separate real architecture from conceptual illustration; label abstraction.

patterns.name: Glass over a controlled surface
patterns.variants: Frosted toolbar; translucent preview; acrylic panel
patterns.use: Layer relationships need subtle depth.
patterns.guard: Test all allowed backgrounds; border/focus remain visible without blur.

patterns.name: Clay and tactile objects
patterns.variants: Soft volume; embossed illustration; material chips
patterns.use: Friendly creative/learning products benefit from tactile art.
patterns.guard: Keep controls recognizable and contrasted; don't use shadow alone as a boundary.

patterns.name: Monochrome with semantic accent
patterns.variants: Grayscale structure; single brand accent; status palette
patterns.use: Dense products need quiet hierarchy.
patterns.guard: Keep error/warning/success distinct from branding and understandable without color.

patterns.name: Whitespace and rule
patterns.variants: Open gap; hairline; section number
patterns.use: Content needs breathing room and a clear break.
patterns.guard: Spacing must represent grouping consistently, including on mobile.

patterns.name: Wave or contour bridge
patterns.variants: Wave; layered curve; topographic transition
patterns.use: Related story sections need a thematic boundary.
patterns.guard: Keep decorative geometry out of text; bound height at narrow widths.

patterns.name: Architectural edge
patterns.variants: Diagonal cut; step; notch; corner reveal
patterns.use: A precise or industrial art direction needs rhythm.
patterns.guard: No clipped copy or interactive areas; maintain real document order.

patterns.name: Editorial interlude
patterns.variants: Large numeral; short quote; chapter label
patterns.use: A long narrative benefits from a meaningful pause.
patterns.guard: Use actual heading hierarchy; avoid an empty full-screen obstruction.

patterns.name: Press and release feedback
patterns.variants: Small scale; surface change; icon response
patterns.use: Confirm that an input was received.
patterns.guard: Keep target stable and action immediate; preserve keyboard focus.

patterns.name: Save with honest recovery
patterns.variants: Pending label; saved timestamp; retry
patterns.use: People edit data that can fail to persist.
patterns.guard: Distinguish local draft and server save; avoid fake success animation.

patterns.name: Reversible optimistic action
patterns.variants: Favorite; archive; local reorder
patterns.use: Low-risk frequent changes benefit from immediacy.
patterns.guard: Track rollback and concurrent changes; never fake confirmed payment or permission change.
patterns.fallback: Wait for confirmation and retain retry.

patterns.name: Copy with confirmation
patterns.variants: Copy reference; code; share link
patterns.use: Users transfer content to another tool.
patterns.guard: Handle clipboard failure; confirm exact copied value type without exposing secrets.

patterns.name: Inline editable record
patterns.variants: Edit in place; confirm/cancel; draft indicator
patterns.use: Small repeated edits benefit from preserved context.
patterns.guard: Define Enter/Escape, validation, dirty state, and stale-value conflicts.

patterns.name: Pointer light as ornament
patterns.variants: Soft spotlight; edge reflection; gentle tilt
patterns.use: A limited product/portfolio card invites exploration.
patterns.guard: Never move the actual hit target; disable for coarse pointer and reduced motion.

patterns.name: Icon continuity
patterns.variants: Play/pause morph; expand/collapse; save check
patterns.use: An icon transition reinforces actual state.
patterns.guard: Keep label/state accessible; don't delay command execution.

patterns.name: Purposeful completion moment
patterns.variants: Brief check; subtle burst; next-action reveal
patterns.use: A real meaningful milestone deserves acknowledgement.
patterns.guard: Don't celebrate routine clicks or sensitive failures; no repeated blocking spectacle.

patterns.name: Drag with explicit alternatives
patterns.variants: Reorder list; kanban move; upload pickup
patterns.use: Spatial movement improves a real workflow.
patterns.guard: Provide move buttons/menu and announce outcome; handle cancellation and permissions.
patterns.fallback: Move-to action and list order controls.

patterns.name: Density without losing meaning
patterns.variants: Compact/comfy rows; detail toggle
patterns.use: Experts need more information while others need space.
patterns.guard: Keep target requirements and text readability; persist user choice appropriately.

patterns.name: List-to-detail continuity
patterns.variants: Shared image; expanding summary; routed detail
patterns.use: Users benefit from seeing where an item went.
patterns.guard: Deep links, back/scroll, focus, and rapid navigation must work without animation.

patterns.name: Master/detail workspace
patterns.variants: List beside detail; responsive inspector
patterns.use: Frequent scanning and inspection should preserve context.
patterns.guard: Keep selected item and unsaved edits safe; avoid tiny panes.

patterns.name: Adaptive sheet to full page
patterns.variants: Compact quick action; tall sheet; mobile editor
patterns.use: The same task must suit different viewport heights.
patterns.guard: No fixed half-screen assumption; handle keyboard, zoom, dismissal, draft.

patterns.name: Command palette with discovery
patterns.variants: Global search; recent objects; scoped commands
patterns.use: Experienced users benefit from fast task access.
patterns.guard: Keep ordinary navigation; label scope and consequences; enforce permissions.

patterns.name: Filter-to-result continuity
patterns.variants: Applied chips; result count; URL state
patterns.use: Exploration should preserve context and shareability.
patterns.guard: Cancel stale requests; keep focus stable; explain zero results.
patterns.fallback: Submit filters with a result heading.

patterns.name: Background job journey
patterns.variants: Queue; progress; notify; durable result
patterns.use: Long work should not block other tasks.
patterns.guard: Expose cancellation limits, partial failure, retries, and notification preferences.
patterns.fallback: Jobs page with status polling/manual refresh.

patterns.name: Draft-to-review-to-receipt
patterns.variants: Autosave; check answers; submit; confirmation
patterns.use: Consequential tasks need correction and proof.
patterns.guard: Clarify committed versus draft data; deduplicate submission; recover session expiry.
patterns.fallback: Explicit staged forms with save and receipt.

patterns.name: Progressive permission request
patterns.variants: Explain value; request at use; denied path
patterns.use: A permission is needed for a user-chosen feature.
patterns.guard: Never gate unrelated features or repeatedly nag after denial.
patterns.fallback: Manual entry or file picker where viable.

patterns.name: Comparison workspace
patterns.variants: Pin candidates; remove; aligned attributes
patterns.use: Users compare multiple options over time.
patterns.guard: Preserve selection across exploration; cap complexity; label differences fairly.

patterns.name: Coordinated map and list
patterns.variants: Select result; highlight pin; preserve viewport
patterns.use: Geographic search needs accessible task parity.
patterns.guard: Avoid unexpected zoom/scroll on every hover; clarify location precision.

patterns.name: Scroll narrative with escape
patterns.variants: Chapter progress; bounded sticky visual; reveal
patterns.use: A public explanation benefits from a sequence.
patterns.guard: Keep native scroll, reading order, keyboard access, and a skip route.

patterns.name: Context-preserving view switch
patterns.variants: Grid/list; calendar/agenda; board/table
patterns.use: Different views answer different questions about the same data.
patterns.guard: Retain filters, selection, sorting where meaningful; explain losses.

patterns.name: Collaborative presence and conflict
patterns.variants: Presence chips; edit locks; merge prompt
patterns.use: Concurrent work creates real coordination needs.
patterns.guard: Presence isn't authorization; protect identity, handle disconnect, and expose conflict.
patterns.fallback: Version check and explicit conflict resolution.

patterns.name: Undo history and recovery
patterns.variants: Recent changes; restore snapshot; reversible batch
patterns.use: Users make many edits or consequential mistakes.
patterns.guard: State undo scope/time and nonreversible actions; check current permission on restore.

patterns.name: User-controlled 3D object
patterns.variants: Rotate product; exploded view; material preview
patterns.use: Spatial inspection materially aids understanding.
patterns.guard: Provide keyboard controls, reset, poster, real dimensions, and bounded rendering.

patterns.name: Generative identity system
patterns.variants: Seeded motifs; data-shaped covers; constrained variation
patterns.use: A brand needs many related original visuals.
patterns.guard: Keep seeds stable; don't encode sensitive data; ensure consistent crop/contrast.

patterns.name: Image comparison reveal
patterns.variants: Before/after slider; split image; toggle
patterns.use: Differences between two genuine states matter.
patterns.guard: Label each state and date; include keyboard slider and side-by-side alternative.

patterns.name: Kinetic headline with restraint
patterns.variants: Word reveal; short scramble; underline draw
patterns.use: A short noncritical headline benefits from one entrance.
patterns.guard: Full text available immediately; no repeated scramble, flashing, or layout jump.

patterns.name: Ambient shader vignette
patterns.variants: Dithered glow; water-like field; material study
patterns.use: An optional brand scene is worth its resource cost.
patterns.guard: No motion behind important reading; stop offscreen and on preference change.

patterns.name: Diagram that explains itself
patterns.variants: Step-highlighted nodes; selectable layers; playback
patterns.use: A process is clearer when readers choose a step.
patterns.guard: Expose every step in text; pause/reset; no knowledge hidden in animation.
patterns.fallback: Labeled static diagram and ordered explanation.

themes.name: Editorial precision
themes.composition: Strong type scale, deliberate asymmetry, captions, thin rules
themes.type_motion: Serif display plus neutral sans; short fades
themes.guard: Avoid tiny captions and forced full-screen headlines.

themes.name: Calm workspace
themes.composition: Stable shell, restrained cards, strong table hierarchy
themes.palette: Cool neutral surfaces and semantic state colors
themes.type_motion: Readable sans, tabular numerals; immediate feedback
themes.guard: Avoid excessive panels and accent competition.

themes.name: Technical blueprint
themes.palette: Deep ink, cool paper, electric accent
themes.type_motion: Sans body with limited mono; line/step reveals
themes.guard: Decorative schematics must not masquerade as actual architecture.

themes.name: Warm humanist
themes.composition: Generous rhythm, rounded but clear controls, real people
themes.guard: Do not use warmth as an excuse for weak text contrast.

themes.name: Monochrome luxury
themes.composition: Large photography, quiet framing, disciplined whitespace
themes.palette: Black/white plus a restrained material color
themes.type_motion: Elegant display face with robust body; sparse transitions
themes.guard: Keep prices, labels, and navigation fully legible.

themes.name: Bold typographic
themes.composition: Oversized type, sharp contrast, clear blocks
themes.palette: One saturated field and controlled neutral
themes.guard: Avoid all-caps paragraphs and clipped translated text.

themes.name: Structured brutalist
themes.composition: Visible rules, hard edges, explicit controls
themes.type_motion: Plain strong type; direct state changes
themes.guard: Preserve familiar control behavior and calm reading areas.

themes.name: Soft tactile
themes.composition: Soft illustration, material hints, clear surface boundaries
themes.palette: Pastels used as surfaces, deep readable text
themes.guard: Neumorphic low-contrast controls are not an acceptable default.

themes.name: Controlled glass
themes.use: Media tools, spatial interfaces, polished overlays
themes.palette: Neutral glass plus solid semantic layers
themes.guard: Needs opaque fallback and tested contrast over every backdrop.

themes.name: Organic landscape
themes.guard: Do not imply environmental evidence through green styling alone.

themes.name: Retro digital
themes.palette: Dark ink and limited bright accents
themes.type_motion: Mono headlines only; optional short reveals
themes.guard: Avoid CRT flicker, illegible pixel body type, and fake console behavior.

themes.name: Scientific clarity
themes.type_motion: Clear sans and tabular data; calm updates
themes.guard: Show uncertainty and provenance, not just visual precision.

themes.name: Cinematic product
themes.composition: Large controlled media, sparse supporting copy
themes.palette: Dark stage, bright subject, limited accent
themes.guard: Maintain lightweight first paint and meaningful posters.

themes.name: Playful modular
themes.composition: Color-coded modules, simple shapes, expressive illustration
themes.palette: Several controlled surface hues with dark text
themes.guard: Do not turn every task into a game or every tile into a button.

themes.name: Architectural minimal
themes.use: Real estate, built environment, professional portfolios
themes.composition: Precise grid, generous image ratios, measured rhythm
themes.guard: Keep essential metadata beside images and visible on mobile.

themes.name: Craft collage
themes.palette: Warm paper and a narrow ink palette
themes.type_motion: Expressive headings, simple body; limited layered reveals
themes.guard: Control visual noise and asset provenance.

themes.name: Chromatic atmosphere
themes.composition: Mesh fields, soft glow, stable foreground panels
themes.palette: Two or three adjacent hues with neutral text surfaces
themes.type_motion: Clean type; static or slow optional atmosphere
themes.guard: Avoid glowing financial/admin forms and uncontrolled contrast.

themes.name: Accessible civic
themes.composition: Clear headings, explicit actions, predictable pages
themes.type_motion: Plain readable type; mostly instant state changes
themes.guard: Novelty must not raise the learning cost of essential tasks.
